subject: reasoning
question:
What is the total number of buses?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e3eaa5735c54375a6306ead9cae05b5f15e6a19d9c46095e184f4b73fe24033.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ceb72bf397000a338b65b6f6953eb976ebcd147bcc3df82777fd367398af02c.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of buses".

So, the total number of buses are = 6 + 4 + 2 + 3 = 15,

Hence, the correct answer is "15".
